229.canonical: Build a developmental inquiry rubric around growing epistemic sophistication — from describing observed features, to recognizing why data must be collected, to recognizing that ideas rest on evidence, to explaining how interpretation of evidence yields new accepted ideas — placing self-scrutiny of evidence (spotting observations that do not fit, deciding when to repeat measurements, judging whether the data suffice) at the higher levels, and awareness of uncertainty and alternative views plus explaining how evidence modified accepted theories at the top.
